### `model`: Model (script)

Builds or changes the part with a script, all or nothing (the language is below).

| Action | Handler | Arguments and notes |
|---|---|---|
| `model.run` | `run_script` | source, dryRun? |

### `features`: Features

Changes the feature tree one step at a time. Faces and edges by name ("n1.top", "n1.side0|n1.side1") or selector ({"feature": 1, "role": "top"}, {"normal": [0, 0, 1], "pick": "max"}, {"between": [face, face]}).

| Action | Handler | Arguments and notes |
|---|---|---|
| `features.command` | `run_command` | command, values?, faces?, edges?, bodies?, point? — a studio command as the toolbar runs it |
| `features.add` | `add_features` | features: [node] — raw feature nodes (sketches, extrudes, revolves, sweeps, lofts, …) |
| `features.edit` | `edit_feature` | index, values? \| feature? |
| `features.parameters` | `set_parameters` | add?, set?, rename?, bind?, remove? — named parameters; bind a feature's value to one |
| `features.load_rows` | `load_rows` | kind, file, part?, feature? — rows from the person’s conversation file |
| `features.delete` | `delete_feature` | index |
| `features.material` | `set_material` | material, bodies?, part? — what bodies are made of |
| `features.stock` | `set_stock` | file?, remove?, allowance? — the shop's stock list and the allowance |
| `features.frame_stock` | `set_frame_stock` | file?, remove?, kerf? — the shop's stock lengths for frames and the saw's kerf |
| `features.frame_sections` | `set_frame_sections` | file?, remove? — your section library: rows a frame names by {kind: "library", id} |
| `features.welds` | `set_welds` | welds?, remove?, beadOwnership? — joint welds; ownership {version:1,policy:"equal-length"}, null removes, absent retains; policy-only allowed |
| `features.casting` | `set_casting` | machined?, allowance?, shrink?, gate? — a casting's machined faces, your allowances and its gate |
| `features.batch` | `apply_ops` | ops: [{tool, args, opId?}], dryRun? — several calls all or nothing |

### `query`: Query

Reads the part without changing it.

| Action | Handler | Arguments and notes |
|---|---|---|
| `query.summary` | `get_part_summary` | body?, page? — features, parameters, bodies, faces and edges by name |
| `query.inspect` | `inspect` | faces?, edges? — detail, neighbours, the feature that made them |
| `query.measure` | `measure` | a, b? — a face or edge, or the distance and angle between two |
| `query.mass` | `mass_properties` | bodies? |
| `query.interference` | `interference` | bodies? — overlap and clearance |
| `query.section` | `section` | axis, at |
| `query.wall` | `wall_thickness` | body?, below? |
| `query.draft` | `draft` | body?, pull?, min_deg? |
| `query.fit_clearance` | `fit_clearance` | hole?, shaft?, hole_class?, shaft_class?, size? — a hole–shaft fit’s limits and clearance from your fit tables |
| `query.rebuild` | `rebuild_report` | — each feature's build time and kernel calls; mate loops |
| `query.welds` | `weld_list` | — the frame's weld joints, seams from the geometry, sizes yours or estimated |
| `query.cutlist` | `cut_list` | csv? — a frame’s members to cut: rows of identical ones, lengths, end cuts, mass; nested into the stock lengths |
| `query.bom` | `output_bom` | expectedRevision? — BOM files |
| `query.purchase_csv` | `output_purchase_csv` | withMade?, expectedRevision? |
| `query.clearance` | `output_clearance` | near?, expectedRevision? — current assembly map |
| `query.cam` | `output_cam_package` | part?, toolDiameter?, expectedRevision? — NOT FOR PRODUCTION |
| `query.render` | `render_views` | highlight?, section? — pictures of the part |
| `query.select` | `select` | faces?, edges?, bodies? — shows them selected in the studio |
| `query.manufacturability` | `check_printability` | direction?, finish?, sides? — the report for the part's process: printing, injection moulding (pull, finish, halves), machining, casting (pull) |

### `history`: History

Snapshots of the part this session.

| Action | Handler | Arguments and notes |
|---|---|---|
| `history.checkpoint` | `checkpoint` | name |
| `history.restore` | `restore` | name |
| `history.best` | `restore_best` | — the best snapshot by the checks |
| `history.diff` | `diff` | from?, to? — checkpoint names, "best" or "current" |

### `requirements`: Requirements

The brief (the part's intent), the locked reference bodies it must fit (datums, keep-outs), and the checks the kernel runs.

| Action | Handler | Arguments and notes |
|---|---|---|
| `requirements.set` | `set_requirements` | requirements: [{id, source, hard?, check}], replace? |
| `requirements.check` | `check_spec` | validate? — every check against the part |
| `requirements.brief` | `set_brief` | fields: {purpose \| process \| material \| …: {value, basis, source?, why?} \| null} — the intent, before the checks |
| `requirements.gaps` | `get_brief` | — the brief, its gaps and what it applies |
| `requirements.references` | `get_references` | — the locked reference bodies, their faces, datums and keep-outs |
| `requirements.reference` | `add_reference` | name, step \| mesh, at? — a locked reference body |
| `requirements.datum` | `add_datum` | reference + face + kind \| reference + vertex \| kind + origin + normal \| direction |
| `requirements.keepout` | `add_keepout` | box \| cylinder \| around + offset, clearance? |
| `requirements.drafts` | `get_drafts` | — features from an image or drawing and their dimensions to confirm |
| `requirements.drawing` | `import_drawing` | dxf, name?, plane? — a DXF profile as a sketch draft |
| `requirements.unref` | `delete_reference_item` | id — a datum or keep-out |
| `requirements.keepouts` | `check_keepouts` | keepout?, body? — clear, violated or undecided, the chord tolerance stated |
| `requirements.ask` | `ask_user` | questions: [{id, text, kind, options?, unit?, blocks: {field} \| {requirement}}] — only what blocks, ≤ 5, ≤ 2 batches |

### `proposals`: Proposals

A change tried on a copy for the user to accept; the part stays as it is.

| Action | Handler | Arguments and notes |
|---|---|---|
| `proposals.propose` | `propose` | title, ops (as features.batch), plan?, requirements? |
| `proposals.accept` | `accept_proposal` | id, leave_out? |
| `proposals.list` | `list_proposals` | all? |

### `assembly`: Assembly

Parts placed and mated with the base part; changes to it are proposed. A part tool with "part" builds that part.

| Action | Handler | Arguments and notes |
|---|---|---|
| `assembly.bundle` | `output_bundle` | baseline?, expectedRevision? — approved current evidence files |
| `assembly.get` | `get_assembly` | faces_of? |
| `assembly.add_part` | `add_part` | name, copy_of?, position?, rotation?, grounded? |
| `assembly.place` | `place_part` | part, position?, rotation?, name?, grounded?, hidden? |
| `assembly.delete_part` | `delete_part` | part |
| `assembly.add_mate` | `add_mate` | kind, a, b, distance?, angle?, flip? |
| `assembly.edit_mate` | `edit_mate` | id, distance?, angle?, flip? |
| `assembly.delete_mate` | `delete_mate` | id |
| `assembly.inputs` | `set_inputs` | inputs: {name: {type, default, bindings, unit?, min?, max?, choices?} \| null} |
| `assembly.variants` | `set_variants` | variants?: {name: {input: value} \| null}, active? |
| `assembly.insert` | `insert_part` | library, part, variant?, params?, name?, position?, rotation? |
| `assembly.snap` | `snap_part` | a, b, offset? |
| `assembly.joints` | `get_joints` | — the assembly as links and joints from its base link |
| `assembly.frames` | `set_frames` | frames: {name: {link, position?, rotation?, kind?} \| null} — tool and sensor frames |
| `assembly.pose` | `forward_kinematics` | values: {joint key: radians \| mm} — where each part is |
| `assembly.set_pose` | `set_pose` | values: {joint key: degrees \| mm} — the robot shown there, nothing stored |
| `assembly.waypoint` | `set_waypoint` | motion, values?, at?, remove?, limits? — a stored motion's waypoints (degrees, mm) |
| `assembly.check_path` | `check_path` | motion — a stored motion checked for contact along its timing |
| `assembly.play` | `play_motion` | motion, samples? — a stored motion's poses over time |
| `assembly.inertia` | `link_inertia` | — each link's mass, centre of mass and inertia (SI, link frame) |
| `assembly.urdf` | `export_urdf` | name? — the robot as URDF, checked |
| `assembly.mjcf` | `export_mjcf` | name? — the robot as a MuJoCo MJCF model, checked |
| `assembly.sweep` | `sweep_path` | to, from? — a joint move checked for collisions, certified |
| `assembly.gravity` | `gravity_torques` | values?, g? — the static torque each joint holds |
| `assembly.move` | `motion_torques` | to, profile, limits, from?, joint_limits? — a move's peak and RMS torques |
| `assembly.size` | `size_actuators` | to, profile, limits, from?, joint_limits?, dwell_s?, life_h?, estop_rad_s2?, coupled?, motors?, reducers? — a motor and reducer per joint, every value sourced |
| `assembly.set_joints` | `set_joints` | base?, joints?: {key: {lower?, upper?, effort?, velocity?} \| null} |
